evidence.citation: “Stop and ask the user to define a gradable bar… Also clarify whether the skill is genuinely conformance-oriented… Echo the agreed bar back for confirmation before running any evaluation.”
evidence.criterion: C1: The artifact does not require materially unnecessary execution work under the supplied cost evaluation bar.

rationale: The artifact requires pre-run clarification and confirmation needed to establish evaluation validity and prevent an answer template from improperly becoming the grading checklist. This is necessary integrity work, not materially unnecessary execution.
